textos.texto: Ana is Peruvian. She comes from Peru, a country in America. Now she lives in Canada. Canada is a very big country and it is not in Europe. Ana speaks Spanish and English. She speaks French too, because in Canada French is a language too. Paul is Canadian. He was born in a small city. He speaks English and French. Ana is a foreigner in Canada, but she is happy here. Where are you from? I am from Peru, she says. And you? I am from here!
